descriptive_title: Kindergarten Mathematics: Demonstrations — Comparing Length, Mass, and Capacity (A10.1-A10.2)
short_description: A 5-day Kindergarten unit on measurement comparison framed around Max the Measure Moose and Tess the Tiny Mouse. Children compare length, mass, and capacity, and measure with non-standard units like cubes.
long_description: Take your Kindergarten class on a measurement adventure with Max the Measure Moose and Tess the Tiny Mouse! This 5-day Ontario-aligned unit covers both A10 expectations (A10.1, A10.2) through play-based, hands-on comparison. Day 1 introduces LENGTH (longer, shorter, same length) using strips and animal tokens. Day 2 introduces MASS (heavier, lighter, same weight) using a paper balance. Day 3 introduces CAPACITY (holds more, holds less, same) by pouring beans. Day 4 teaches non-standard units (cubes, hand-spans, footsteps) and the 'no gaps' rule. Day 5 closes with a Measurement Carnival capstone where children rotate through 3 stations applying everything. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a specific Kindergarten trap: eyeball comparison, size-mass conflation, height-capacity conflation, gap measurement, wrong-tool use), 5 student worksheets with answer keys, 12 paper manipulatives (length strips, paper balance, object cards, cup cards, linking cubes, carnival template, anchor charts, animal tokens, poster, two character puppets), a mid-unit formative check, an end-of-unit reflection sheet, a class diagnostic checklist, three formative trackers, a 2-row summative rubric on Ontario's 4-level scale, a summative task script with phase-by-phase administration guidance, and Junior Measure Captain certificates. Pedagogical approach: hands-on play-based learning with explicit attribute vocabulary, structured pair work, and rich teacher-puppet narrative.
